message: You know, I never really thought much about power outages until I experienced one during a summer storm. It wasn’t too bad, though, thanks to some simple tips I picked up. I found that being prepared turned what could have been a stressful evening into a cozy candlelit adventure! If you’re curious about how to make the best of a blackout, I came across a great resource that covers all the essentials. Have you ever had to deal with a power outage? How did you manage?
